test-code.description: bad: large connection timeout literals and property
test-code.code:
import org.apache.http.client.config.RequestConfig import org.springframework.http.client.HttpComponentsClientHttpRequestFactory
class BadTimeouts { private val connectTimeout: Int = 5000
fun buildConfig(): RequestConfig = RequestConfig.custom() .setConnectTimeout(5000) .setConnectionRequestTimeout(3000) .build()
fun buildFactory(): HttpComponentsClientHttpRequestFactory { val factory = HttpComponentsClientHttpRequestFactory() factory.setConnectTimeout(connectTimeout) return factory } }

import org.apache.http.client.config.RequestConfig
class GoodTimeouts { fun buildConfig(): RequestConfig = RequestConfig.custom() .setConnectTimeout(30) .build() }
